BAYT.reason: a bayt is the couplet-unit of a ghazal. A ghazal has no chorus and no verse; calling it `verse` would be this vocabulary claiming a form it does not describe (doctrine 43).

CRUNLUATH.reason: the closing pìobaireachd variation, the most ornamented. Same refusal as `SIUBHAL`. Two of the three staged instances print `(FINALE)` after it, which this reader keeps as the mark's ANNOTATION rather than as a second mark — an editor's gloss on a heading is apparatus.

CYWYDD.reason: a Welsh METRE name, not a section.

PANTUN.reason: a pantun is a whole quatrain FORM, not a section of a song.

PART.reason: a speaker or role attribution in the Kalevala wedding songs (`[PART: Kaason puoli]`), not a section function.

QUATRAIN.reason: a printing/metrical unit, and the mark carries its rhyme scheme rather than a function.

RADIF.reason: a radif is a RHYME DEVICE -- the repeated word after the rhyme -- not a span of the song. It has no bars and no return.

SIUBHAL.reason: a pìobaireachd variation on the ùrlar. Refused for the same reason and with the same regret: the relation it needs is a POINTER at the section it elaborates, and the section vocabulary has no pointer yet (`quality/SECTION_ORDER_PREREGISTRATION.md`).

SLOKA.reason: a sloka is a metrical stanza-unit. In the Gitagovinda it is an interleaved narrative verse, and the source says so; that is a position in a text, not a function in a form.

URLAR.reason: the GROUND of a pìobaireachd — the theme the variations are built on. It IS a span of the performance, which is why it is a mark at all; what this vocabulary has no member for is a movement in a VARIATION LADDER, and folding it into `verse` would say the theme and its ornamented restatements are the same kind of thing (the argument PATTER's old refusal made, one tradition over — PATTER itself entered the vocabulary 2026-08-28 because a printed witness supplied its function; the ùrlar still lacks a MOVEMENT layer, not a witness).

VARIANT.reason: Lonnrot's numbered alternative READING of the same passage. An editor's variant is not a performed return, and treating it as one would count editorial apparatus as structure.
